reviews.title: Great value case
reviews.comment: It's a great tower, especially for the price.  If you're looking for a case that won't break the bank, but will look amazing showing off the inside of your computer, this is one to look at.  The built in RGB fans look great if you're into that and they provide plenty of airflow to keep temperatures stable.  There's room at the top to add a radiator for a watercooler, and also plenty of space for an air cool tower if you prefer.  Cable management is easy, with rubber gaskets surrounding the holes and a good bit of space hidden behind the panel.  It is a bit of a tight squeeze and I had to apply a little pressure to get that side back on the case, but I am very happy with the final results.
reviews.author: Donald Benhardt Jr

reviews.title: Best Mid ATX Case for the price, I love MONTECH!
reviews.comment:
This PC case is amazing! I bought this case to replace my be quiet case that looked ugly, and I switched from an aio to an air cooler.
Pros:
-Size: Mid tower but has a lot of room
-Fans: The 3 preinstalled fans are pre daisy chained which made installing easy.
-High quality: The case is super high quality, lots of cable management room, the process for installing the components were easy and straight forward compared to my be quiet case.
-Easy to add extra case fans: I bought thermalright c12c-s fans in a 5 pack and installed 3 intake on the bottom and 2 exhaust fans on the top middle. They all connected so all my components have the same rgb showing at the same time
Cons:
-Glass: came dirty with scratches, I tried to clean it but it didn't come out. Isn't a big deal to me
reviews.author: Bryce

reviews.title: Best case I have ever bought
reviews.comment:
I recently upgraded my setup with the montech xr Gaming Computer Case, and I couldn't be happier! From the moment I unboxed it, the build quality stood out. The sleek design and tempered glass panels give it a premium look that fits perfectly in my gaming corner.
Installation was a breeze thanks to the well-thought-out cable management features and ample space for all my components. I appreciate the tool-less drive bays, which made adding my SSD and HDD hassle-free. The airflow is exceptional—my system runs cool even during long gaming sessions.
One of my favorite features is the customizable RGB lighting. It adds a vibrant touch to my rig and syncs seamlessly with my other peripherals. Plus, the noise levels are impressively low, allowing me to immerse myself fully in my games.
Overall, the montech xr Gaming Computer Case offers fantastic value for money. Whether you’re a casual gamer or a hardcore enthusiast, this case has everything you need to showcase your build beautifully. Highly recommend!
reviews.author: Eli

reviews.title: Hands down best value for the price it’s at
reviews.comment:
The media could not be loaded.  https://m.media-amazon.com/images/I/B1DdFn10gPL.mp4 https://m.media-amazon.com/images/I/51zNa3fHbqL._SY256.jpg For the price this is the best bang for your buck when it comes to cases. The actual case is metal and it’s high quality. It doesn’t bend or it’s not malleable, it’s a material you would see in a 100+ dollar case. In addition the glass and back panels are very easy to take off and on.
The fans are neatly managed in the back and are very quiet and have exceptional lighting. In addition in the actual case are cutouts for easy cable management and have a dedicated spot for a hard drive, sata drive, and a spot to stuff PSU cables in.
The temps are normal when using it, no problem with that. In addition it comes with three dust filters; one on the PSU, side, and top. My PSU dust filter actually came in damaged but the customer service was so fast and shipped one to me right away .
This case is such a W and the best in the market for an aquarium style case. It has amazing cable management and looks so good including the fans. Would 100 percent recommend.

reviews.title: A most excellent case.
reviews.comment: Lots of room, airy, easy to work with, easy to hide wires. I LOVE the power button on the lower front of the case, I'm so tired of power buttons on top, it's not friendly for cat owners because those lovable furballs WILL get on top when you aren't looking and switch the pc off. I also dropped the big front panel on the floor, edge first and while giving me a stroke and fear of it shattering, IT DID NOT. Super sturdy. Heavy. Good design.
